name: unienv
description: Use your computer's always-ready document, PDF, OCR and data tools from Claude: read, create and convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files locally.
long_description: UniEnv AI gives every AI tool on your computer one shared, pre-installed environment (python-docx, openpyxl, python-pptx, pandas, pypdf, pandoc, LibreOffice, Poppler, tesseract and more). This extension connects Claude Desktop to it, so chat can read local documents, create and edit Office files, convert formats and run Python with those packages, without installing anything per task. Requires UniEnv to be installed: https://github.com/rupeshbharambe24/unienv-ai
